hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -Eq 'git push[^|]*(--force|-f\b)|git reset --hard|git branch -D|git push[^|]*--delete|rm -rf +(/|~|\$HOME)/?\*?( |$)|DROP (TABLE|DATABASE)'; then echo 'Blocked: destructive command. Ask a human for explicit confirmation (AGENTS.md, Security).' >&2; exit 2; fi

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; fail() { echo "$1 Resolve the findings before continuing." >&2; exit 2; }; case "$f" in *package.json|*package-lock.json) [ -f package-lock.json ] || exit 0; npm audit --audit-level=high >&2 || fail 'npm audit failed.';; *requirements*.txt) command -v pip-audit >/dev/null || exit 0; pip-audit -r "$f" >&2 || fail 'pip-audit failed.';; *pyproject.toml) command -v pip-audit >/dev/null || exit 0; pip-audit "$(dirname "$f")" >&2 || fail 'pip-audit failed.';; esac; true

cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && { [ -f tasks/todo.md ] && echo '## tasks/todo.md' && cat tasks/todo.md; [ -f tasks/lessons.md ] && echo '## tasks/lessons.md' && cat tasks/lessons.md; git log --oneline -5 2>/dev/null; } ; true

if [ "$(jq -r '.stop_hook_active // false')" = 'true' ]; then exit 0; fi; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; [ -f package.json ] || exit 0; fail() { echo "$1 Fix it before ending the session (AGENTS.md, handoff)." >&2; exit 2; }; npm test >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'The test suite is failing.'; tsc=node_modules/.bin/tsc; if [ -f tsconfig.json ] && [ -x "$tsc" ]; then "$tsc" --noEmit >/dev/null 2>&1 || fail 'The type check is failing.'; fi; true
